reason: Machine lens: all opcodes are 65SC12-legal (LDA zp A5, SBC (zp) F2 is a CMOS opcode in a cmos section, no BBR/BBS/RMB/SMB). Moving LDA &CE above the label swaps two 2-byte instructions within the same region: no byte count change, nothing after &1C5A moves. The loop is &1C58-&1C67 in the listing; the BNE at &1C66 now targets &1C5C (offset F4 instead of F2), same page, still a taken in-page branch (3 cycles). SBC (&CE) has no index so no page-cross penalty either way. Per column after the first the loop body loses LDA zp = 3 cycles; the first column costs the same (LDA moves before the label, still executed once). A on the back edge equals the stored &CE (STA, BCS, DEC zp, SEC, DEX, BNE do not write A); C=1 on entry and back edge as before. No self-modifying operand or label+1 reference involved; the only reference to clip_flipped_column_c1 is the in-loop BNE. Recount: 3 cycles per repeated column, 0 bytes.
